package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/courseplan"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type CoursePlanHandler struct {
	Create          courseplan.Create
	DiagnosticState courseplan.GetDiagnosticPlanning
}

func (handler CoursePlanHandler) GetDiagnosticPlanningState(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if r.URL.RawQuery != "" || r.ContentLength > 0 {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	studentID, planID := chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "planID")
	if !canonicalHandlerUUID(studentID) || !canonicalHandlerUUID(planID) {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, domain.ErrMalformed)
		return
	}
	state, err := handler.DiagnosticState.Handle(r.Context(), studentID, planID)
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticError(w, err)
		return
	}
	writeDiagnosticJSON(w, http.StatusOK, state)
}

type teacherCoursePlanPayload struct {
	GoalCode         string                     `json:"goal_code"`
	LearningPathID   string                     `json:"learning_path_id"`
	DesiredOutcome   string                     `json:"desired_outcome"`
	RequestedTargets []domain.TargetRef         `json:"requested_targets"`
	Constraints      domain.PlanningConstraints `json:"constraints"`
	AuditRefs        domain.PlanningAuditRefs   `json:"audit_refs"`
	Reason           domain.PlanningReason      `json:"reason"`
	DiagnosticPlanID string                     `json:"diagnostic_plan_id"`
}

type teacherCoursePlanResponse struct {
	RequestID      string                  `json:"request_id"`
	GoalCode       string                  `json:"goal_code"`
	Status         domain.CoursePlanStatus `json:"status"`
	ResultCode     string                  `json:"result_code,omitempty"`
	CourseID       string                  `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LearningPathID string                  `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
	Reused         bool                    `json:"reused"`
	Attempts       int                     `json:"attempts"`
	CreatedAt      string                  `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt      string                  `json:"updated_at"`
	CompletedAt    string                  `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
	Source         domain.PlanningSource   `json:"source"`
	Reason         domain.PlanningReason   `json:"reason"`
}

func (handler CoursePlanHandler) CreateTeacherCoursePlan(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "studentID"))
	idempotencyKey := strings.TrimSpace(request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
	parsedStudent, err := uuid.Parse(studentID)
	if err != nil || parsedStudent.String() != studentID {
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_student_id")
		return
	}
	parsedKey, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey)
	if err != nil || parsedKey.String() != idempotencyKey {
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_idempotency_key")
		return
	}
	var payload teacherCoursePlanPayload
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, 64<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	if payload.Reason == "" {
		payload.Reason = domain.PlanningReasonInitial
	}
	result, created, err := handler.Create.Handle(request.Context(), courseplan.CreateInput{
		StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey, GoalCode: payload.GoalCode,
		LearningPathID:   payload.LearningPathID,
		DiagnosticPlanID: payload.DiagnosticPlanID,
		Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{
			Source: domain.PlanningSourceTeacher, Reason: payload.Reason,
			DesiredOutcome: payload.DesiredOutcome, RequestedTargets: payload.RequestedTargets,
			Constraints: payload.Constraints, AuditRefs: payload.AuditRefs,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		writePrivateCoursePlanDomainError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	status := http.StatusAccepted
	if !created && result.Status != domain.CoursePlanPlanning {
		status = http.StatusOK
	}
	response := teacherCoursePlanResponse{
		RequestID: result.ID, GoalCode: result.GoalCode, Status: result.Status,
		ResultCode: result.ResultCode, CourseID: result.CourseID, LearningPathID: result.LearningPathID, Reused: result.Reused,
		Attempts: result.Attempts, CreatedAt: result.CreatedAt.UTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999999Z07:00"),
		UpdatedAt: result.UpdatedAt.UTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999999Z07:00"),
		Source:    result.Intent.Source, Reason: result.Intent.Reason,
	}
	if result.CompletedAt != nil {
		response.CompletedAt = result.CompletedAt.UTC().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999999Z07:00")
	}
	writePrivateCoursePlanJSON(writer, status, response)
}

func writePrivateCoursePlanDomainError(writer http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusConflict, "idempotency_conflict")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden):
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden")
	default:
		writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error")
	}
}

func writePrivateCoursePlanError(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	writePrivateCoursePlanJSON(writer, status, map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}

func writePrivateCoursePlanJSON(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(payload)
}
